patches.name: Travian Tools
patches.description: Alerts for finished builds, incoming attacks, full storage and your hero, plus a Travian Tools app with a build queue, oasis finder, silver helper and home-screen widget. Uses your existing game login.

patches.name: Travian Tools setup
patches.description: Required by Travian Tools. Registers its screens and widget. Keep this on.
